label: CONNECTION

points.heading: Stay curious
points.body: People keep changing. Keep learning who your partner is now.
points.panel: “What’s something you’ve been thinking about lately?”

points.heading: Protect regular time together
points.body: Closeness needs a place on the calendar.
points.panel: Keep one standing evening a week, just for the two of you.

points.heading: Say the good things out loud
points.body: Saying kind things often helps a relationship feel warm and safe.

points.heading: Repair quickly
points.body: Small hurts fixed early don’t grow into distance.
points.panel: “That came out wrong. Can I try again?”

resource.name: The Devotion System
resource.covers: Guidance for confidence, communication, and long-term closeness.

caption:
Love in a long marriage isn’t only a feeling. It’s a choice you keep making, in small ways, again and again.

These four habits help you keep choosing each other. If you’d like guidance for confidence, communication, and long-term closeness, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how another person will feel.

Follow @spotseason for more small steps.
